name: Coding Interviews
description: Learn the patterns still missing, then solve interview problems against the clock while you explain them.

lessonNames.l3-window-maximum: The maximum of a sliding window
lessonNames.l4-top-k: The k largest and the running median
lessonNames.l14-rate-limiter: Counting events in a time window

lessonObjectives.l1-merging-intervals: Sort and merge intervals, and count overlaps with a sweep.
lessonObjectives.l2-prefix-trees: Build a trie and use it for prefix search and word lookups.
lessonObjectives.l3-window-maximum: Keep a monotonic deque to find every window's maximum in linear time.
lessonObjectives.l4-top-k: Use a size-k heap and two heaps for top-k and streaming medians.
lessonObjectives.l5-bit-tricks: Use XOR, masks and shifts for the classic bit problems.
lessonObjectives.l6-anagrams-and-palindromes: Solve string questions with counts, two pointers and expanding centres.
lessonObjectives.l7-parsing-with-a-stack: Evaluate and decode nested expressions with a stack.
lessonObjectives.l8-simulating-the-rules: Turn a long rule statement into a correct simulation, as online assessments often ask.
lessonObjectives.l9-grids-and-matrices: Traverse, rotate and flood-fill a matrix without off-by-one errors.
lessonObjectives.l10-matching-engine: Simulate price-time priority matching of limit and market orders.
lessonObjectives.l11-lru-cache: Combine a hash map and a linked list for constant-time get and put.
lessonObjectives.l12-file-system: Design classes for a small file system with paths, folders and files.
lessonObjectives.l13-requirements-change: Extend working code when the interviewer adds a requirement part-way.
lessonObjectives.l14-rate-limiter: Design a sliding-window counter and a rate limiter for timestamped events.
lessonObjectives.l15-reading-an-assessment: Triage an assessment's problems and plan the minutes before writing code.
lessonObjectives.l16-edge-cases-first: List edge cases and write tests before the solution.
lessonObjectives.l17-two-in-sixty: Solve two medium problems inside 60 minutes, with a plan for partial credit.
lessonObjectives.l18-talking-while-coding: Explain the plan and its trade-offs aloud while writing the code.
lessonObjectives.l19-a-live-round: Work a 45-minute live problem with two follow-ups.
